gloss: only in the case of; precisely when; of all things, just when

definitions.gloss: (limiting) only; only in the case of; limited to
definitions.explanation: Marks a specific case or a restricted group as the only one that applies, excluding all others. Equivalent to 'only' or 'exclusively' and often used in formal notices and announcements.

definitions.gloss: (unexpected coincidence) of all times; precisely when; just when it was that
definitions.explanation: Used to express that a negative or inconvenient event happens at exactly the worst possible moment, or that someone normally reliable does something out of character. Conveys surprise, frustration, or irony about the timing or actor.

definitions.gloss: (confident denial) ... of all people; surely not X
definitions.explanation: Used with a negative or a rhetorical question to express strong confidence that the person or thing named would not do the thing in question. Often paired with はずがない or そんなことはない.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}に{限|かぎ}って{半額|はんがく}です。
examples.english: Today only, everything is half price.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{会員|かいいん}に{限|かぎ}って{割引|わりびき}がある。
examples.english: This shop offers discounts only for members.

examples.japanese: {本日|ほんじつ}に{限|かぎ}り、ご{予約|よやく}なしでもご{入店|にゅうてん}いただけますので、お{気軽|きがる}にお{越|こ}しください。
examples.english: Today only, you may enter without a reservation, so please feel free to come by.

examples.japanese: {急|いそ}いでいる{時|とき}に{限|かぎ}って{電車|でんしゃ}が{遅|おく}れる。
examples.english: The train is always late exactly when I'm in a hurry.

examples.japanese: {傘|かさ}を{持|も}っていない{日|ひ}に{限|かぎ}って{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}る。
examples.english: It rains precisely on the days I don't have an umbrella.

examples.japanese: {大事|だいじ}な{会議|かいぎ}がある{日|ひ}に{限|かぎ}って{寝坊|ねぼう}してしまい、{本当|ほんとう}に{自分|じぶん}が{嫌|いや}になる。
examples.english: I always oversleep on days when I have important meetings; I really get fed up with myself.

examples.japanese: うちの{子|こ}に{限|かぎ}ってそんなことをするはずがない。
examples.english: My child of all people would never do such a thing.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}に{限|かぎ}って{嘘|うそ}をつくとは{思|おも}えない。
examples.english: Of all people, I can't imagine him telling a lie.

examples.japanese: あの{真面目|まじめ}な{山田|やまだ}さんに{限|かぎ}って、{無断|むだん}で{欠勤|けっきん}するなんてことはあり{得|え}ない。
examples.english: Of all people, it's inconceivable that the conscientious Mr. Yamada would skip work without notice.

notes:
Formed from the particle に, the verb {限|かぎ}る ('to limit') in its て-form, and an implicit reference back to the preceding noun. Structurally equivalent to 'limited to X' → 'only in the case of X', with two major extended uses for unexpected coincidences and confident denials.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [noun] + に{限|かぎ}って — sense 1 and 2
- [noun] + に{限|かぎ}り — a slightly more formal variant, especially common in signs and announcements; typically carries sense 1 only
- [noun (person)] + に{限|かぎ}って + ... はずがない / とは{思|おも}えない / そんなことはない — sense 3

SENSE 2 — UNEXPECTED COINCIDENCE:
With time expressions or situations, に{限|かぎ}って conveys the speaker's feeling that an inconvenient event happens specifically at the worst possible time. The tone is almost always emotional — frustrated, resigned, or ironic.

SENSE 3 — CONFIDENT DENIAL:
With a person's name or a group, に{限|かぎ}って expresses the speaker's strong belief that this particular person (unlike others) would not do the thing described. The clause that follows is nearly always negative in form or meaning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {今日|きょう}に{限|かぎ}って: only today; precisely today
- {会員|かいいん}に{限|かぎ}って: only for members
- ～する{時|とき}に{限|かぎ}って: precisely when ...
- うちの{子|こ}に{限|かぎ}って: my child of all people
- ～に{限|かぎ}りません: is not limited to ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- だけ: only — general limiting particle; more neutral and does not carry the strong 'specifically this one' emphasis.
- のみ: only — formal / written synonym of だけ, similarly neutral.
- ～に{限|かぎ}る: to be limited to; to be the best — same verb, but used predicatively (e.g., {夏|なつ}はビールに{限|かぎ}る, 'in summer, beer is the best').
- ～ばかり: only; nothing but — implies repetition or exclusivity of an activity; does not carry the 'of all times/people' nuance.
